decisions.reason: Removing the approval gate's quota-counting rule does not change the established submission channels, batch format, deadline, or link-access rules.
The qualification process was already completed, and removal of the monthly quota-counting rule does not alter that historical completion state.
The source does not change any clip-duration limit or resolve the existing uncertainty about shorter clip styles.
The quota-counting removal does not change which source videos or B-roll may be used.
The source does not revise the requirement that clips deliver complete, standalone lessons, stories, or points.
The source decision does not alter the clean-editing, effects, or transition standards.
The source does not change any caption color, font, effects, lettering, or positioning rule.
The same source message establishes and evidences failure of the communication expectation, but removing the separate approval quota-counting rule does not modify that expectation.
The source does not establish or change any standard for selecting strong or impactful source moments.
The quota-counting removal has no effect on the requirement to remove distracting wind noise.
